data.text_label: Conflict recovery must follow the canonical workflow under orchestrator ownership after the guarded merge has completed its conflict-time baseline stage; conflicted merge outcomes do not generate views or write a sync-base record.

data.text_label: When a guarded base merge conflicts, its conflict outcome regenerates the baseline from the exact base commit it incorporated, reports any baseline-stage failure, and surfaces the canonical recovery workflow entry point. It does not generate derived views, write a sync-base record, or record cleanup completion.
